top_diagnoses.diagnosis: Complex rearranged small supernumerary marker chromosome
top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The presence of a de novo sSMC, characterized as a complex rearrangement involving chromosomes 13 or 21 and 22, along with developmental delay and dysmorphic features, supports this diagnosis.
The patient's presentation with polysplenia, cardiac anomalies, extrahepatic biliary atresia, intestinal malrotation, and dysmorphic features aligns with this condition.

While the patient has polysplenia and cardiac anomalies, the absence of reported skeletal or genitourinary anomalies and the presence of other features not typical of Ivemark Syndrome make this a less likely diagnosis.
